content: Streaks exploit loss aversion (~2-2.5x), ~20-40% DAU lift, but streak loss is a documented exit point for loyal users (many report relief). Duolingo: Weekend Amulet +4% week-later return, 5% fewer lost streaks; Streak Wager +14% D7; bingers abandon more than pacers. Lally: missing ONE day reduced automaticity by only 0.29 (negligible); missing a week derails. Gamified streaks foster app dependency rather than autonomous habit.
